author: Staff Writer
title: United Way hosts Keys food drive - NewsBreak
text:
By Staff Writer ,
9 hours ago MONROE COUNTY — United Way of Collier and the Keys will conduct its annual "Feed the Keys" food drive on Friday, Oct. 17, from 2-6 p.m. at three sites in the Florida Keys.
This community-wide event boosts nutritious food supplies at local food pantries, supporting the 45% of residents who live paycheck-to-paycheck and often struggle with food insecurity.
Community members can drop off non-perishable food donations at Burton Memorial United Methodist Church in Tavernier, Keys Area Interdenominational Resource in Marathon and Star of the Sea Foundation in Key West.
In 2023 and 2024, the food drive collected 14,309 pounds of food. Following last year’s May event, UWCK also distributed $3,000 in additional funding to seven local food pantries, providing vital support for families in need.
For more information, visit uwcollierkeys.org/feedthekeys. For sponsorship opportunities, contact brittni.brown@uwcollierkeys.org, and for general questions, contact laura.collett@uwcollierkeys.org.
